concept: Morning airfield year with album vignettes
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography of a real small airfield, using large physical runway markings for the year and staging the album portraits and motifs as crisp, believable on-site tableaux around them.
scene: A small rural airfield seen from a slightly elevated, near-face-on viewpoint in bright early morning light. The giant digits 2026 are painted across the pale concrete or tarmac of the runway/apron, spanning most of the frame width, with open grassy edges and low countryside beyond.

elements.element: the person from reference image 1 stands on the grass verge behind the year, back to camera, wide-legged, hands clasped behind, wearing the long red, white, and blue flag-patterned coat
the woman from reference image 2 reclines on a lavender fabric spread on the tarmac edge beside one digit, with the two large dogs pressed against her in the same intimate pose

a red painted safety marker or lightweight airfield cutout shaped like the horned winged figure stands near the runway edge, backed by a blue opening and warm swirling painted graphics on a service wall

the two women from reference image 4 pose together beside a hangar wall painted yellow-green, wearing their pale blue and white floral kimonos, one with white face makeup and open-mouthed hands-to-cheeks expression, the other smiling with one eye closed and holding the fan
the rose tattoo and hanging cross pendant from reference image 5 appear as a close foreground crop of a person leaning into the lower edge of frame, used once as a partial body detail only

the blonde woman from reference image 6 stands near a baggage trolley or bouquet stand by the digits, wearing the sparkling crown, open-mouthed expression, dark tear-streaked eye makeup, clutching the wrapped flowers

the two small children from reference image 7 sit together on a white airport chair near the apron edge, smiling, with an orange repeating pattern translated into a sunshade panel behind them and subtle pink-purple tint in nearby props
clusters of translucent prism-like taxiway markers and taut white guide cables cast rainbow refractions across parts of the tarmac and digits

mood: clear, celebratory, slightly surreal but grounded

coverSummaries.description: A full-body color photograph of one person seen from behind, standing wide-legged on vivid green grass with hands clasped behind the back. The person wears a long coat patterned like a red, white, and blue flag, with black trousers and black boots. Behind them is a bright rural landscape with rolling fields, a line of trees, a body of water, and a dramatic blue sky with scattered clouds. The figure is centered and dominates the composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: the back view of a person in a long red, white, and blue flag-patterned coat
coverSummaries.people: one person standing with back to camera in a long patterned coat

coverSummaries.description: A soft-focus color photograph framed within a white border, showing one woman reclining in translucent lavender fabric. Her dark hair spreads out around her head, and two large gray-brown dogs press against her on either side, one with its head near her neck and chest. The scene is intimate and dreamy, with a hazy purple atmosphere and close cropped composition.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a reclining woman embraced by two large dogs
coverSummaries.people: one woman reclining in sheer fabric with two dogs against her

coverSummaries.description: A surreal illustrated cover with a red devil-like humanoid figure standing in the center, outlined with a glowing edge. The figure has horns and one visible bat-like wing, and raises a hand to its forehead. It stands against a blue, starry, space-like opening, surrounded by swirling yellow, orange, and red abstract forms around the edges. The composition is bold and psychedelic.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a red horned devil figure with a bat-like wing

coverSummaries.description: A color photograph of two women posed against a flat yellow-green backdrop. Both wear patterned kimonos in pale blue and white with floral motifs. The woman on the left has white face makeup and holds her cheeks with an open-mouthed expression. The woman on the right smiles with one eye closed, one hand on her hip, and holds an open folding fan near her face. The figures fill most of the frame.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two women in floral kimonos, one holding a fan
coverSummaries.people: two women posing in patterned kimonos, one with white face makeup and one holding a fan

coverSummaries.description: A close-cropped color photograph of a bare upper torso and arm. A dark cross pendant on a cord hangs over the chest. On the upper arm is a tattoo of a pink rose with green leaves and a blue ribbon. The skin-toned background fills the frame, with the necklace and tattoo as the main visual elements.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a rose tattoo on a bare upper arm beside a hanging cross pendant
coverSummaries.people: one partially visible person shown as a bare torso and arm

coverSummaries.description: A grainy color photograph of one blonde woman wearing a sparkling crown and heavy eye makeup with dark streaks running down from the eyes. She smiles or shouts with mouth open while clutching a bouquet of flowers wrapped in clear plastic. The background is a dark purple curtain, and the image has a raw flash-lit look.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a crowned blonde woman holding a bouquet with smeared eye makeup
coverSummaries.people: one blonde woman wearing a crown and holding flowers

coverSummaries.description: A tinted photograph of two small children close together, smiling and facing slightly to the side, with a white chair partially visible on the left. The top portion of the cover is filled with an orange floral or geometric repeating pattern. The children and lower image area are heavily tinted pink and purple, creating a posterized, dreamy effect.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two smiling small children in a pink-purple tinted photograph
coverSummaries.medium: tinted photograph with graphic patterned overlay
coverSummaries.people: two small children smiling close together

coverSummaries.album: The Dark Side of the Moon
coverSummaries.description: A minimalist graphic design on a black background featuring multiple translucent triangular prism shapes clustered in the center. Thin white beams cross diagonally through the composition, while several rainbow light bands enter and exit from different directions. The image is abstract, geometric, and high contrast.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: triangular prism shapes intersected by white beams and rainbow bands

prompt: Huge physically painted runway digits "2026" spanning at least half the width of a small rural airfield apron, seen from a slightly elevated near-face-on viewpoint so the numbers read flat and bold in the upper two-thirds of the frame; around and behind the year, stage a crisp real-world morning scene with the person from reference image 1 standing on the grassy verge behind the digits, back to camera, wide-legged with hands clasped behind the back, wearing the long red, white, and blue flag-patterned coat; the woman from reference image 2 reclining on translucent lavender fabric at the tarmac edge beside one digit with the two large dogs pressed against her in the same intimate pose; the two women from reference image 4 posed beside a yellow-green hangar wall in their pale blue and white floral kimonos, one with white face makeup holding her cheeks open-mouthed, the other smiling with one eye closed and holding an open fan; the blonde woman from reference image 6 near the digits wearing a sparkling crown and heavy streaked eye makeup, mouth open, clutching a wrapped bouquet; the two small children from reference image 7 seated together on a white chair near the apron edge, smiling, with an orange repeating patterned shade panel behind them; include the rose tattoo on a bare upper arm and hanging cross pendant from reference image 5 as a single close foreground body detail at the lower edge only; translate reference image 3 into a red horned winged safety-marker cutout or painted airfield sign near a service wall with a blue opening and warm swirling graphics; translate reference image 8 into translucent prism-like markers and thin white cables creating real rainbow light bands across the tarmac. Photographic realism, daylight location photography, clean lens, high clarity, no haze, no fog, no heavy grain. Compose with the year as the dominant first read and the portraits as supporting vignettes arranged clearly without overlapping faces. Use low-angle early morning sunlight with crisp long shadows, bright blue sky, saturated but natural color. Palette of runway white, sky blue, fresh green, lavender, red, yellow-green, orange, and small rainbow accents; mood celebratory, open, fresh, and slightly surreal but believable. The year "2026" appears exactly once as runway-painted digits on airfield, built into the scene and lit like the rest of the photograph. It is the dominant subject and the first thing the eye reads: the digits span at least half the width of the frame, sit high or centred rather than along the bottom edge, and read face-on and legibly at thumbnail size, with the album motifs and people arranged around it. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one person standing with back to camera in a long patterned coat; reference image 2 shows one woman reclining in sheer fabric with two dogs against her; reference image 4 shows two women posing in patterned kimonos, one with white face makeup and one holding a fan; reference image 5 shows one partially visible person shown as a bare torso and arm; reference image 6 shows one blonde woman wearing a crown and holding flowers; reference image 7 shows two small children smiling close together. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. The only lettering anywhere in the image is the year "2026": those four digits, spelled exactly 2 0 2 6, appearing once, large and legible, as a physical part of the scene rather than an overlay. Include no other readable text or lettering of any kind: no other words, letters, numbers, dates, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
